newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-TURK TEENAGER KILLS FRIEND IN GOAL CELEBRATION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TURK TEENAGER KILLS FRIEND IN GOAL CELEBRATION.

text.p: A Turkish teenager shot and killed his friend while celebrating Turkey's first goal in their 7-0 victory over San Marino in a world cup qualifier on Sunday, the Hurriyet daily reported on Monday.
The 17-year-old soccer fanatic was detained by police after his friend died in hospital in the coastal town of Antalya, Hurriyet said.
"I caused my close fried's death while wanted to show my joy by firing a gun, I am very sory for that," the daily quoted him as saying.
Turkish fans often fire guns in the air to show their excitement after key victories. Many people are killed or wounded in soccer celebrations.
